author: world today news
title: Investigation Underway Following Deaths of Gene Hackman and Betsy Arakawa
text:
• Gene Hackman, 95, and his wife, Betsy Arakawa, 63, were found dead in their Santa Fe, New Mexico home on February 26.
• The couple was discovered after a neighbor requested a welfare check due to concerns for their well-being.
• Santa Fe County Sheriff’s Office is leading the investigation into the circumstances surrounding their deaths.
• Authorities found the main door of the residence open and discovered the couple's bodies along with one deceased dog; two other pets were alive.
• A search warrant was secured to conduct a detailed investigation of the scene.
• Sheriff Adan Mendoza stated there were no visible signs of trauma, and the cause of death is currently undetermined.
• The bodies had reportedly been in the residence for at least a day, and initial assessments did not indicate a gas leak.
• The couple was found in different rooms: Hackman in the mudroom and Arakawa in a bathroom next to a heater.
• An open jar of medications and scattered pills were found near Arakawa.
• Hackman's family is considering the possibility of carbon monoxide poisoning as a contributing factor to their deaths.
• The New Mexico Gas Company and fire department were called to check for hazardous gases at the residence.
• Gene Hackman and Betsy Arakawa had lived in their Santa Fe home since Hackman's retirement from Hollywood in 2004.
• The property is valued at $3.8 million and features extensive living space surrounded by natural vegetation.
• The investigation is ongoing, and autopsy results are awaited to clarify the cause of death.
